actualWeight.description: Measured weight from the SLAM scale, in the same unit as expectedWeight (e.g. kilograms). An explicit null is accepted and treated the same as 0 (Go's JSON decoding cannot distinguish them).

expectedWeight.description: Expected weight for this order's contents, in the same unit as actualWeight. An explicit null is accepted and treated the same as 0 (Go's JSON decoding cannot distinguish them).
